verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents a one-click sweep that clears non-important email in bulk, plus plain-English AI filters that label, star and archive mail automatically, and a user reports clearing a weeks-old backlog in 10 minutes. However, bulk actions are only described at a marketing level: there is no documentation of multi-select operations or of asking the AI assistant to act on many threads at once. missing for 10: documented multi-select/batch actions (archive, label, delete across selections), AI-assistant-driven bulk operations on search results, detail on scale limits or undo for bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest.
Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
In 10min I cleared my inbox which I was postponing for a few weeks
